snippet.title: BOOMER | Demo Out Now!!!
snippet.description:
We're so excited for you to try out BOOMER! Demo out on Steam now for Windows & MacOS!!!

A chaotic co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Scavenge eerie environments, feed your loot to a hungry steam train, and pass Boomer between teammates in a deadly game of hot potato.

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4353060/BOOMER/
